sampling_note: Each grid point measures actual error on four newly selected training examples. Changing examples between neighboring points creates most of the jaggedness; this is a noisy error estimate, not proof that the full-data error surface is jagged.
notes: Line shows where saved training positions land in this view; its height follows the displayed surface. Training moves in more ways than these two axes show.
projection: Least-squares projection of saved weight changes onto the same two patterns used by the surface. Bias changes and all remaining weight changes are excluded.
height: Bilinear lookup of the existing displayed grid, not checkpoint error. A 0.8% display-height lift keeps the line visible.
